# SourciaVera

> Independent third-party factory verification, supplier audits, and pre-shipment inspections for importers in the US, UK, and Latin America. Based in Guangzhou, China. Pricing starts at $349 per audit. Reports delivered within 48 hours. Zero factory commissions — we work for buyers only.

- [Factory Verification Overview](https://sourciavera.com/): Homepage with full service description and pricing

- [Verification Services by Country](https://sourciavera.com/verification-services/): Country-specific service pages
- [Mexico Factory Verification](https://sourciavera.com/verification-services/mexico/): Services for Mexican importers
- [Small Batch Manufacturing](https://sourciavera.com/small-batch): Small order sourcing and custom manufacturing
